mentions.name: Ferry ticket web app
mentions.description: A simple web app that tracks the local ferry system, scans and holds ferry tickets locally on the device, and displays a large, easy-to-scan barcode for ferry workers, replacing physical ticket passes.
mentions.problem: The local ferry tracking app failed on the author's old phone, and a physical ticket with 10 passes worth a couple hundred dollars was lost.
mentions.source_excerpt: I spent a few weeks building a simple web app that scans and holds the ticket locally, and also gives a nice big simple bar code for the ferry workers to scan.  Second test was a success.

evidence.value: I spent a few weeks building a simple web app that scans and holds the ticket locally, and also gives a nice big simple bar code for the ferry workers to scan.  Second test was a success.
